name: Gitman
known_for: Shirts and Ties Made in the USA

prices.note: Men's woven shirts (button-ups, flannels, wool shirts, overshirts) at regular price; tees, knits, polos, sweats, shirt jackets and padded or quilted overshirts excluded. products.json for sport-shirts (47), weekend-shirts (8) and formal-shirts (3): 58 shirts, all regular. Indigo Denim Shirt $250; Blue Oxford Weekend Shirt $255; Tan Flannel (Albini, Italy) $295; Green Checked 120's Poplin $325.

notes: Homepage: og:title 'Gitman Shirts & Ties | Made In The USA'; meta 'Since 1978, Gitman Bros. has been manufacturing the finest shirts and ties in the USA' (https://www.gitman.com/). Heritage page: Max Gitman founded the Ashland Shirt & Pajama Company in 1932 in Ashland, Pennsylvania; footer 'Proudly Made in Lafayette, TN' (https://www.gitman.com/pages/heritage). founded_year left empty: 1932 and 1978 both appear.

FAQ: free UPS standard shipping in the US (no minimum shown); international express $30, countries not listed, duties paid by recipient; return authorization within 14 days for full-price items, 7 days for markdowns up to 40% (https://www.gitman.com/pages/faq).
Style & fit: Tailored, Regular and Classic fits; Big and Tall Fit dress shirts; S–XXL, collars 14½–22 (https://www.gitman.com/pages/style-and-fit).
Disco and the Apart Style pool name it 'Gitman Vintage', the company's heritage label; the store now sells everything under 'Gitman' (products.json vendor 'Gitman').
